Fields.Name: Enabled: Message ID
Fields.Description: Prompt shown when the player can use this, such as Open. -1 shows no prompt.

Fields.Name: Failed: Message ID
Fields.Description: Prompt shown when the player tries this without meeting the requirement. -1 shows no prompt.

Fields.Name: Bypass Qualification Check: Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag that skips this interaction's requirements. While it is on, anyone can use this. -1 means no flag skips them.

Fields.Name: Use Distance
Fields.Description: How close the player must stand to use this, in centimetres. 150 is roughly two paces. Larger values allow use from further away.

Fields.Name: Use Action: Player Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the player acts out while using this, such as pushing a door. It must be an animation the player model has.

Fields.Name: Use Action: Character Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation a non-player character acts out while using this. It must be an animation that character's model has.

Fields.Name: Qualification ID: 1
Fields.Description: Item or effect the player must have to use this. The requirement type beside it says which list to read. Leave it 0 for no requirement.

Fields.Name: Qualification ID: 2
Fields.Description: Second item or effect the player must have. Works like the first requirement. Leave it 0 to use only one.

Fields.Name: Use: Dummy Polygon ID
Fields.Description: Anchor point on the object where the prompt appears. It must be a point the object's model has.

Fields.Name: Use: Object Animation ID
Fields.Description: Animation the object plays when used, such as a lid swinging open. It must be an animation the object's model has.

Fields.Name: Valid Player Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How far off-centre the object can be before the prompt hides, in degrees. 30 needs rough facing. 180 allows any direction.

Fields.Name: Qualification Type: 1
Fields.Description: What the first requirement ID means. 0 needs nothing, 1 reads it as an item, 2 as an effect.

Fields.Name: Qualification Type: 2
Fields.Description: What the second requirement ID means. 0 needs nothing, 1 reads it as an item, 2 as an effect.

Fields.Name: Valid Object Angle (degrees)
Fields.Description: How far around the object the player can stand and still use it, in degrees. 30 needs the marked side. 180 allows every side.

Fields.Name: Character Attraction Type
Fields.Description: How the player slides into place when starting to use this. What each value does is not established.

Fields.Name: Interaction Activation Timing
Fields.Description: When the linked event starts during the use animation. What each value does is not established.
